rules.R1: Diabetes with CKD: E11.22 plus the N18 stage, replacing E11.21/E11.29. FY2027 Guidelines I.A.15 'With' (p11) and Tabular E11.22 'Use additional code to identify stage of chronic kidney disease'.
rules.R2: Diabetes with hyperglycemia: E11.65 replaces R73.9. ICD-10-CM Alphabetic Index, Diabetes, type 2, with hyperglycemia E11.65; Tabular R73 Excludes1 diabetes mellitus (E08-E13).
rules.R3: Prediabetes R73.03 is dropped when an E11 code is present. Tabular R73 Excludes1 diabetes mellitus (E08-E13).
rules.R4: E11.9 (without complications) is dropped when another E11 code is present. Tabular title of E11.9.
rules.R5: Hypertension with CKD: I12.9 (CKD 1-4) or I12.0 (CKD 5/ESRD) replaces I10. FY2027 Guidelines I.C.9.a.2 (p50).
rules.R6: Hypertension with heart failure: I11.0 replaces I10 (I50 code kept). FY2027 Guidelines I.C.9.a.1 (p50).
rules.R7: Hypertension with heart failure and CKD: I13.0 (CKD 1-4) or I13.2 (CKD 5/ESRD) replaces I10/I11/I12. FY2027 Guidelines I.C.9.a.3 (p51).
rules.R8: One CKD stage: Synthea leaves earlier stages active, so only the highest documented N18 stage is kept. FY2027 Guidelines I.C.14.a.1 (p62): with both a stage and ESRD documented, assign N18.6 only.

support.note: A note in the 12-month window names the Synthea condition (its SNOMED display text).
support.medication: A medication in the chart has a Synthea reasonReference to the condition.
support.lab: The latest value in the window meets a published criterion (below).

criteria.hyperglycemia: Diabetes supported and plasma glucose (2339-0 or 2345-7) >= 200 mg/dL (ADA random-glucose criterion).
criteria.ckd3: Two eGFR (33914-3) values < 60 at least 90 days apart, latest 30-59 (KDIGO 2024 chronicity and G3).
criteria.ckd4: Two eGFR values < 60 at least 90 days apart, latest 15-29 (KDIGO 2024 G4).
criteria.hyperlipidemia: LDL (18262-6 or 2089-1) >= 160 or total cholesterol (2093-3) >= 240 mg/dL (NCEP ATP III).
criteria.anemia: Hemoglobin (718-7) < 13.0 g/dL in men or < 12.0 g/dL in women (WHO).

support.combination: E11.22 needs both the diabetes and the CKD parts supported; I12.9 needs hypertension and CKD.
